questions.text: Which Russian pronoun means 'we'? Choose the correct word.
questions.solution: мы = we. вы = you (plural or polite), они = they, я = I
questions.hint: Think of the pronoun that goes with verbs ending in -ем, as in «___ живём»

questions.text: What does the Russian pronoun «она» mean? Answer in English.

feedback.he: он means 'he'; она is the feminine pronoun

questions.solution: она = she (or 'it' for a feminine noun such as книга)
questions.hint: It is the feminine partner of он

questions.text: What is the gender of the noun «окно» (window)?
questions.solution: Nouns ending in -о or -е are usually neuter, so окно is neuter
questions.hint: Look at the last letter of the word

questions.text: Most Russian feminine nouns end in which letters in the nominative singular?

feedback: Most masculine nouns end in a consonant

questions.solution: Most feminine nouns end in -а or -я, e.g. мама, неделя
questions.hint: Think of the Russian words for 'mum' and 'week'

questions.text: «Я читаю» — which tense is this? Answer in English: past, present or future.
questions.solution: читаю is present tense: I read / I am reading
questions.hint: Past-tense verbs end in -л, -ла, -ло or -ли; future forms often use буду

questions.text: Which short Russian word goes before a verb to make it negative (like 'not')? Type it in Cyrillic.

feedback.нет: нет means 'no' or 'there is no'; to negate a verb use не

questions.solution: не goes before the verb: Я не знаю = I don't know
questions.hint: It is a two-letter word that starts with н

questions.text: Choose the correct past-tense form: «Вчера мама ___ книгу.» (читать = to read)
questions.solution: The past tense agrees with the subject: мама is feminine, so читала
questions.hint: Is the subject masculine, feminine or plural?

questions.text: Which word for 'my' goes with «сестра» (sister)?
questions.solution: сестра is feminine, so моя сестра
questions.hint: сестра ends in -а: what gender is it?

questions.text: «Я буду играть» — which tense is this? Answer in English: past, present or future.
questions.solution: буду + infinitive is the future: I will play / I will be playing
questions.hint: буду comes from быть (to be) and points forward in time

questions.text: Give the plural of «книга» (book). Type it in Cyrillic.
questions.solution: After г, к and х you write -и, not -ы: книга → книги
questions.hint: Remember the spelling rule for nouns ending in -га

questions.text: Which sentence means 'I don't like sport'?
questions.solution: не before the verb makes it negative: Я не люблю спорт
questions.hint: Look for the small word that means 'not'

questions.text: Translate into English: «Он не работает.»
questions.solution: не + работает: he does not work / he isn't working (about a machine: it doesn't work)
questions.hint: работать means 'to work'; не makes it negative

questions.text: Complete with the prepositional case: «Я живу в ___.» (Москва)

feedback: Москву (accusative) is used for movement: Я еду в Москву

questions.solution: в + prepositional shows where something is: Москва → в Москве
questions.hint: Location after в takes the prepositional case

questions.text: Complete with the accusative case: «Я вижу ___.» (сестра = sister)
questions.solution: The direct object goes into the accusative: сестра → сестру
questions.hint: Feminine nouns ending in -а change their ending in the accusative

questions.text: Complete with the correct form of «говорить» (to speak): «Мы ___ по-русски.» Type the verb in Cyrillic.
questions.solution: говорить: я говорю, ты говоришь, он говорит, мы говорим, вы говорите, они говорят
questions.hint: The мы form of an -ить verb ends in -им

questions.text: Translate into English: «Я играл в футбол.»
questions.solution: играл is past tense (masculine): I played football
questions.hint: играть в + a sport = to play a sport; the -л ending shows the past

questions.text: Which form is perfective, describing one completed action?
questions.solution: The prefix про- makes the perfective: прочитал = read (and finished)
questions.hint: Perfective verbs often add a prefix to the imperfective verb

questions.text: What does «У меня есть брат» mean? Answer in English.
questions.solution: У меня есть = I have; брат = brother
questions.hint: У меня есть is the usual way to say what you own

questions.text: Which case follows «у» in «У сестры есть кошка»?
questions.solution: у always takes the genitive: сестра → у сестры
questions.hint: Look at the ending -ы on сестры

questions.text: Complete: «Я пишу ___.» (I write with a pen. ручка = pen; use the instrumental case)
questions.solution: The instrumental of feminine nouns in -а ends in -ой: ручка → ручкой
questions.hint: The instrumental case shows the tool you use

questions.text: Which case follows «с» when it means 'with', as in «чай с молоком»? Give the case in English.
questions.solution: с meaning 'with' takes the instrumental: молоко → с молоком
questions.hint: Look at the ending -ом on молоком

questions.text: Put into the past tense for a female speaker: «Я (делать) домашнее задание.» Type the verb in Cyrillic.

feedback.делал: делал is the masculine form; the speaker is female

questions.solution: Take off -ть and add -ла for a feminine subject: делать → делала
questions.hint: Past-tense endings depend on the gender of the speaker

questions.text: Choose the correct verb: «Каждый день я ___ в школу на автобусе.»

feedback: еду is one trip by transport, happening now
хожу is for repeated trips on foot
иду is one trip on foot, happening now

questions.solution: Regular trips by transport use ездить: я езжу (every day, by bus)
questions.hint: Is it a repeated trip, and is it on foot or by transport?

questions.text: Translate into English: «Мы будем жить в Москве.»

accept: we will be living in Moscow
we are going to live in Moscow
we're going to live in Moscow
we shall be living in Moscow

questions.solution: будем + жить is the future: we will live in Moscow
questions.hint: будем is the мы form of the future of быть

questions.text: «Когда я был маленьким, я часто играл в парке.» Why is the imperfective «играл» used?

options: It describes a repeated action in the past

questions.solution: Imperfective verbs describe repeated or ongoing actions; часто (often) signals repetition
questions.hint: Look at the word часто (often)

questions.text: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
questions.solution: к (towards) takes the dative: врач → к врачу
questions.hint: Which case does к take?

questions.text: Which sentence correctly means 'I have no time'?

feedback: After нет the noun must be genitive: времени

questions.solution: нет meaning 'there is no' takes the genitive: время → времени
questions.hint: After нет meaning 'there is no', the noun goes into the genitive

questions.text: In «Я поеду в Россию», which tense is «поеду»? Answer in English: past, present or future.

feedback.present: Perfective verbs have no present tense: поеду means 'I will go'

questions.solution: A perfective verb with present-tense endings has future meaning: поеду = I will go
questions.hint: по- makes ехать perfective; think about what a perfective verb with present endings means

questions.text: Complete with the correct form of «мой»: «Я позвонил ___ брату.» Type the word in Cyrillic.

feedback.моего: моего is genitive/accusative; позвонить needs the dative

questions.solution: позвонить takes the dative, and мой agrees: моему брату
questions.hint: позвонить (to phone someone) is followed by the dative case

questions.text: In «Мы говорили о брате», which case is «брате»? Give the case in English.
questions.solution: о (about) takes the prepositional: брат → о брате
questions.hint: Which case follows о when it means 'about'?

questions.text: What does «брат» mean? Choose the correct translation.
questions.solution: брат = brother; сестра = sister; отец = father; дядя = uncle
questions.hint: It sounds a little like the English word

questions.text: What does «сестра» mean? Answer in English.
questions.solution: сестра = sister; брат = brother
questions.hint: It is a female family member of the same generation

questions.text: What does «бабушка» mean? Choose the correct translation.
questions.solution: бабушка = grandmother (grandma); дедушка = grandfather
questions.hint: The male partner of this word is дедушка

questions.text: What does «учитель» mean? Answer in English.
questions.solution: учитель = teacher (a female teacher is учительница)
questions.hint: This person works in a школа (school) and gives lessons

questions.text: Which Russian word means 'school'?
questions.solution: школа = school; работа = work; больница = hospital; магазин = shop
questions.hint: It sounds like the English word

questions.text: Type the Russian word for 'mum' in Cyrillic.
questions.solution: мама = mum; папа = dad
questions.hint: It sounds almost the same as the English word 'mama'

questions.text: What does «весёлый» mean when describing a person?
questions.solution: весёлый = cheerful, fun; ленивый = lazy; серьёзный = serious; застенчивый = shy
questions.hint: It describes someone who laughs a lot

questions.text: Which Russian word means 'lazy'?
questions.solution: ленивый = lazy; умный = clever; добрый = kind; высокий = tall
questions.hint: It is the opposite of трудолюбивый (hard-working)

questions.text: What does «умный» mean? Answer in English.
questions.solution: умный = clever, intelligent
questions.hint: A student who gets top marks is often called this

questions.text: What does «врач» mean? Answer in English.
questions.solution: врач = doctor; больница = hospital
questions.hint: This person works in a больница (hospital)

questions.text: Which Russian verb means 'to get up'?
questions.solution: вставать = to get up; ложиться = to go to bed; завтракать = to have breakfast; умываться = to wash
questions.hint: Think of the first thing you do after waking up

questions.text: Type the Russian word for a male 'friend' in Cyrillic.
questions.solution: друг = (male) friend; подруга = (female) friend
questions.hint: It is a four-letter word starting with д

questions.text: «Мой брат высокий и спортивный.» What is the brother like?
questions.solution: высокий = tall, спортивный = sporty
questions.hint: спортивный looks like an English word

questions.text: «Я встаю в семь часов.» At what time does the person get up?
questions.solution: семь = seven, so в семь часов = at seven o'clock
questions.hint: Count in Russian: один, два, три, четыре, пять, шесть…

questions.text: «Моя мама работает в больнице.» Where does the mother work?
questions.solution: больница = hospital; в больнице = in a hospital
questions.hint: The word больница is linked to больной (ill)

questions.text: «Я хочу стать инженером.» What job does the person want to do? Answer in English.
questions.solution: стать + instrumental: инженер → инженером = engineer
questions.hint: Take the ending -ом off the job word and it looks like English

questions.text: Complete with the я form of «завтракать» (to have breakfast): «Я ___ в семь часов.» Type the verb in Cyrillic.
questions.solution: завтракать: я завтракаю, ты завтракаешь, он завтракает
questions.hint: Take off -ть and add the я ending -ю

questions.text: Which sentence means 'My friend is kind'?
questions.solution: друг = friend, добрый = kind
questions.hint: Find the sentence with both 'friend' and 'kind'

questions.text: Read: «В школе я изучаю химию и историю. Мой любимый предмет — история, а химия очень трудная.» Which statement is true?

options: The writer does not study chemistry

questions.solution: Мой любимый предмет — история = my favourite subject is history; химия очень трудная = chemistry is very hard
questions.hint: любимый means 'favourite'

questions.text: Read: «Летом мой брат будет работать в кафе, потому что ему нужны деньги.» Why will the brother work?
questions.solution: ему нужны деньги = he needs money
questions.hint: деньги means 'money'

questions.text: Read: «Чтобы быть здоровым, я каждый день пью воду и занимаюсь спортом.» Apart from doing sport, what does the person do every day? Answer in English.
questions.solution: пью воду = I drink water; занимаюсь спортом = I do sport
questions.hint: пью comes from пить (to drink)

questions.text: Read: «Раньше я ел много сладкого, а теперь я ем фрукты.» What does the person eat now? Answer in English.

feedback.sweets: That is what the person ate before (раньше)

questions.solution: теперь = now; фрукты = fruit; раньше (before) the person ate lots of sweet things
questions.hint: Find теперь (now) and read what comes after it

questions.text: Change into the past tense (the speaker is male): «Я работаю в банке.» Type the verb only, in Cyrillic.

feedback.работала: работала is feminine; the speaker is male

questions.solution: работать → работал (masculine past)
questions.hint: Take off -ть and add the masculine past ending

questions.text: Read: «После школы я хочу поступить в университет и изучать медицину.» What are the person's plans?

options: To go to university and study medicine
To find a job in a hospital
To travel and then study medicine
To leave school and start work

questions.solution: поступить в университет = to get into university; изучать медицину = to study medicine
questions.hint: университет and медицину look like English words

questions.text: Read: «Мой отец — врач. Он много работает, но говорит, что его работа интересная. Я не хочу быть врачом: я хочу стать учителем.» Which statement is accurate?

options: The writer wants to become a teacher
The writer's father finds his job boring
The writer wants to be a doctor like his father

questions.solution: я хочу стать учителем = I want to become a teacher; the father says his work is interesting
questions.hint: Look at the last sentence: стать means 'to become'

questions.text: Read: «Анна раньше много сидела в интернете, но теперь она гуляет каждый день и рано ложится спать.» What has changed in Anna's lifestyle?

options: She now goes to bed late
She has stopped going for walks
She now walks every day and goes to bed early
She now spends more time online

questions.solution: теперь = now: она гуляет каждый день (walks every day) и рано ложится спать (goes to bed early)
questions.hint: Contrast раньше (before) with теперь (now)

questions.text: Which sentence means 'I get on well with my sister'?
questions.solution: ладить с + instrumental = to get on with; хорошо = well
questions.hint: хорошо means 'well' and плохо means 'badly'

questions.text: Read: «Мой друг очень надёжный: он никогда не опаздывает.» What does «надёжный» mean? Answer in English.
questions.solution: надёжный = reliable; он никогда не опаздывает = he is never late
questions.hint: The second half of the sentence says he is never late

questions.text: Read: «Брат редко занимается спортом, но часто играет в компьютерные игры.» How often does the brother do sport? Answer in English.

feedback.often: часто means 'often' and goes with computer games

questions.solution: редко = rarely; часто = often
questions.hint: Contrast the two adverbs: one of them means 'often'

questions.text: Complete with the correct form of «сестра»: «Я часто звоню ___.» Type the noun in Cyrillic.

feedback.сестру: сестру is accusative; звонить needs the dative

questions.solution: звонить (to phone someone) takes the dative: сестра → сестре
questions.hint: звонить is followed by the dative case

questions.text: What does «плавание» mean? Choose the correct translation.
questions.solution: плавание = swimming; бег = running; танцы = dancing
questions.hint: You do this in a бассейн (pool)

questions.text: What does «книга» mean? Answer in English.
questions.solution: книга = book; читать книгу = to read a book
questions.hint: You read it

questions.text: Which Russian word means 'song'?
questions.solution: песня = song; музыка = music; игра = game; книга = book
questions.hint: A singer sings one of these

questions.text: What does «чай» mean? Answer in English.
questions.solution: чай = tea; кофе = coffee
questions.hint: A hot drink often served with lemon in Russia

questions.text: What does «хлеб» mean? Choose the correct translation.
questions.solution: хлеб = bread; молоко = milk; сыр = cheese; мясо = meat
questions.hint: You buy it at a bakery

questions.text: Type the Russian word for 'milk' in Cyrillic.
questions.solution: молоко = milk
questions.hint: It has three syllables, each with the vowel о

questions.text: Choose the verb used with sports: «Я ___ в теннис.»
questions.solution: играть в + sport: Я играю в теннис = I play tennis
questions.hint: You 'play' a sport

questions.text: «Я играю на гитаре.» What does this mean?
questions.solution: играть на + instrument = to play an instrument
questions.hint: гитаре looks like an English word

questions.text: What does «смотреть телевизор» mean? Answer in English.
questions.solution: смотреть = to watch; телевизор = television
questions.hint: телевизор looks like an English word

questions.text: What does «праздник» mean? Answer in English.
questions.solution: праздник = festival, holiday, celebration (e.g. Новый год)
questions.hint: Новый год (New Year) is a famous example

questions.text: Which phrase means 'social media'?
questions.solution: социальные сети = social networks, social media
questions.hint: сеть means 'network'

questions.text: Type the Russian word for 'sport' in Cyrillic.
questions.solution: спорт = sport; заниматься спортом = to do sport
questions.hint: It is spelt with the Cyrillic letters for s, p, o, r and t

questions.text: «В свободное время я люблю читать и рисовать.» What does the person like doing?
questions.solution: читать = to read; рисовать = to draw
questions.hint: читать means 'to read'

questions.text: «Я слушаю музыку каждый вечер.» When does the person listen to music?
questions.solution: каждый вечер = every evening
questions.hint: вечер is the part of the day after afternoon

questions.text: «Мы ходили в кино в субботу.» Where did they go? Answer in English.
questions.solution: кино = cinema; в субботу = on Saturday
questions.hint: You watch films there

questions.text: «Мне нравится этот фильм, потому что он смешной.» What is the film like?
questions.solution: смешной = funny
questions.hint: смех means laughter

questions.text: Complete with the correct form of «любить» (to like, to love): «Я ___ плавать.» Type the verb in Cyrillic.
questions.solution: любить: я люблю, ты любишь, он любит (note the extra л in the я form)
questions.hint: The я form of любить has an extra л before the ending

questions.text: «Моя любимая еда — пицца, а мой любимый напиток — сок.» What is the favourite drink?
questions.solution: напиток = drink; сок = juice
questions.hint: напиток means 'drink'

questions.text: Read: «Раньше я много смотрел телевизор, но теперь я смотрю фильмы на телефоне.» Which statement is true?

options: He watches films at the cinema
He now watches films on his phone
He watches more TV now than before

questions.solution: теперь я смотрю фильмы на телефоне = now I watch films on my phone
questions.hint: Contrast раньше (before) with теперь (now)

questions.text: Read: «Новый год — мой любимый праздник. Мы украшаем ёлку и дарим подарки.» What do they do at New Year?

options: eat pancakes and burn a straw figure
decorate a tree and give presents

questions.solution: украшаем ёлку = we decorate the (fir) tree; дарим подарки = we give presents
questions.hint: ёлка is a fir tree

questions.text: Read: «По выходным я катаюсь на коньках.» What does the person do at weekends? Answer in English.
questions.solution: кататься на коньках = to skate (коньки = skates)
questions.hint: коньки are boots with blades for the ice

questions.text: Read: «Я редко пользуюсь социальными сетями, потому что это пустая трата времени.» What does the writer think social media is? Answer in English.
questions.solution: пустая трата времени = a (complete) waste of time
questions.hint: трата comes from тратить (to spend); времени means 'of time'

questions.text: Put «смотреть» into the past tense (the speaker is female): «Вчера я (смотреть) интересный фильм.» Type the verb in Cyrillic.

feedback.смотрел: смотрел is masculine; the speaker is female

questions.solution: смотреть → смотрела (feminine past)
questions.hint: Take off -ть and add the feminine past ending

questions.text: «Я предпочитаю читать электронные книги.» What does the person prefer?
questions.solution: предпочитать = to prefer; электронные книги = e-books
questions.hint: электронные looks like an English word

questions.text: Read: «Я люблю спорт, но больше всего мне нравится плавание. Я хожу в бассейн три раза в неделю.» Which statement is accurate?

options: The writer prefers running to swimming
Swimming is the writer's favourite sport
The writer goes to the pool every day
The writer does not like sport

questions.solution: больше всего мне нравится плавание = I like swimming most of all; три раза в неделю = three times a week
questions.hint: больше всего means 'most of all'

questions.text: Read: «Технологии полезны, но мои родители считают, что я слишком много времени провожу за телефоном.» What do the writer's parents think?

options: The writer should buy a new phone
The writer does not use the phone enough
The writer spends too much time on the phone

questions.solution: слишком много времени = too much time; провожу за телефоном = I spend on the phone
questions.hint: слишком means 'too'

questions.text: Read: «На Масленицу люди едят блины и прощаются с зимой.» What is Maslenitsa about?
questions.solution: прощаются с зимой = they say goodbye to winter; блины = pancakes
questions.hint: прощаться means 'to say goodbye'

questions.text: Read: «Я больше не играю в компьютерные игры.» What has the person stopped doing? Answer in English.
questions.solution: больше не = no longer: I no longer play computer games
questions.hint: больше не means 'no longer'

questions.text: Read: «Если будет хорошая погода, мы поедем на дачу.» Where will they go if the weather is good? Answer in English.
questions.solution: дача = a dacha, a country house where many Russians spend weekends
questions.hint: Many Russian families have a small house outside the city

questions.text: Complete with the instrumental case: «Я занимаюсь ___.» (спорт) Type the noun in Cyrillic.
questions.solution: заниматься takes the instrumental: спорт → спортом
questions.hint: Masculine nouns ending in a consonant add -ом in the instrumental

questions.text: What does «поезд» mean? Choose the correct translation.
questions.solution: поезд = train; самолёт = plane; автобус = bus; машина = car
questions.hint: It runs on rails

questions.text: What does «море» mean? Answer in English.
questions.solution: море = sea; на море = at the seaside
questions.hint: You swim in it on a beach holiday

questions.text: Which Russian word means 'shop'?
questions.solution: магазин = shop; музей = museum; вокзал = station; парк = park
questions.hint: French has a very similar word for a shop: magasin

questions.text: What does «город» mean? Answer in English.
questions.solution: город = town or city
questions.hint: Москва and Лондон are examples

questions.text: What does «дождь» mean? Choose the correct translation.
questions.solution: дождь = rain; снег = snow; ветер = wind; солнце = sun
questions.hint: You need an umbrella for it

questions.text: Type the Russian word for 'house' in Cyrillic.
questions.solution: дом = house, home
questions.hint: It is a three-letter word starting with д

questions.text: «Сегодня холодно.» What is the weather like today?
questions.solution: холодно = it is cold; жарко = it is hot
questions.hint: Think of холодильник (fridge)

questions.text: Which Russian word means 'to the left' (as in 'turn left')?
questions.solution: налево = left; направо = right; прямо = straight on; назад = back
questions.hint: The word for 'right' is направо

questions.text: What does «направо» mean in directions? Answer in English.
questions.solution: направо = to the right; налево = to the left
questions.hint: налево means 'left'; this is the opposite direction

questions.text: What does «самолёт» mean? Answer in English.
questions.solution: самолёт = plane; лететь на самолёте = to fly
questions.hint: It takes you to the аэропорт (airport) and flies

questions.text: Which phrase means 'by bus'?
questions.solution: на автобусе = by bus; на поезде = by train; пешком = on foot; на машине = by car
questions.hint: автобус looks like an English word

questions.text: Type the Russian word for 'snow' in Cyrillic.
questions.solution: снег = snow; идёт снег = it is snowing
questions.hint: It is a four-letter word starting with с

questions.text: «Я живу в квартире на третьем этаже.» Where does the person live?

options: in a flat on the first floor
in a hotel near the sea
in a flat on the third floor
in a house in the country

questions.solution: квартира = flat; на третьем этаже = on the third floor
questions.hint: квартира means 'flat'; третий means 'third'

questions.text: «Летом мы ездили на море.» What did they do in the summer?
questions.solution: ездили на море = went to the seaside
questions.hint: море means 'sea'

questions.text: «В нашем городе есть большой парк.» What is there in their town? Answer in English.
questions.solution: большой парк = a big park
questions.hint: большой means 'big'

questions.text: «Сколько стоит эта сумка?» What is the person asking about the bag? Answer in English.
questions.solution: Сколько стоит…? = How much does … cost?
questions.hint: Look at the question word at the start: it asks about an amount

questions.text: Complete with the accusative case for movement: «Я еду в ___.» (Москва) Type the noun in Cyrillic.
questions.solution: в + accusative shows movement into a place: Москва → в Москву
questions.hint: Feminine nouns in -а change their ending in the accusative

questions.text: «Завтра будет солнечно.» What will the weather be like tomorrow?
questions.solution: солнечно = sunny (from солнце, sun)
questions.hint: солнце means 'sun'

questions.text: Read: «Мне нравится мой район, потому что здесь тихо, но нет кинотеатра.» What is the problem with the area?
questions.solution: нет кинотеатра = there is no cinema; тихо = quiet
questions.hint: нет + genitive means 'there is no'

questions.text: Read: «Мы должны меньше ездить на машине и больше ходить пешком, чтобы защитить природу.» What does the writer suggest?
questions.solution: меньше ездить на машине = drive less; больше ходить пешком = walk more
questions.hint: меньше means 'less' and больше means 'more'

questions.text: Read: «Чтобы попасть на вокзал, идите прямо, потом поверните налево.» After going straight on, which way do you turn? Answer in English.
questions.solution: идите прямо = go straight on; поверните налево = turn left
questions.hint: Look at the word after поверните (turn)

questions.text: Read: «В прошлом году мы отдыхали в горах.» Where did they spend their holiday? Answer in English.
questions.solution: в горах = in the mountains (гора = mountain)
questions.hint: гора means 'mountain'

questions.text: Complete with the prepositional case: «Я был в ___.» (магазин = shop) Type the noun in Cyrillic.

feedback.магазин: After в meaning 'in', the noun needs the prepositional

questions.solution: в + prepositional for location: магазин → в магазине
questions.hint: Masculine nouns ending in a consonant add -е in the prepositional

questions.text: Read: «В будущем я хотел бы поехать в Сибирь, потому что там красивая природа.» Why does the writer want to go to Siberia?
questions.solution: там красивая природа = the nature there is beautiful
questions.hint: природа means 'nature'

questions.text: Read: «Глобальное потепление — серьёзная проблема. Каждый может что-то сделать: например, экономить энергию и сортировать мусор.» Which statement is accurate?

options: Everyone can do something, such as saving energy
Only governments can solve the problem
Global warming is not a serious problem

questions.solution: Каждый может что-то сделать = everyone can do something; экономить энергию = save energy
questions.hint: каждый means 'everyone'

questions.text: Read: «Мы остановились в гостинице недалеко от центра. Номер был маленький, но чистый.» What was the hotel room like?
questions.solution: маленький = small; чистый = clean; но = but
questions.hint: чистый means 'clean'

questions.text: Which sentence means 'I would like to travel to Russia'?

options: Я не хочу ехать в Россию.
Я хотел бы поехать в Россию.

questions.solution: хотел бы = would like (бы makes the conditional); в Россию = to Russia
questions.hint: The conditional in Russian uses the past tense plus бы

questions.text: Read: «Если бы у меня были деньги, я бы купил машину.» What would the person buy? Answer in English.
questions.solution: Если бы… я бы купил машину = if I had money, I would buy a car
questions.hint: машина is the object of купил

questions.text: Read: «Вокзал находится напротив банка.» Where is the station? Answer in English.

accept: across the road from the bank

questions.solution: напротив + genitive = opposite: напротив банка = opposite the bank
questions.hint: напротив is a preposition of place that takes the genitive

questions.text: Complete: «Мы поедем в Петербург на ___.» (поезд — by train) Type the noun in Cyrillic.

feedback.поезд: After на meaning 'by', use the prepositional

questions.solution: на + prepositional for transport: поезд → на поезде
questions.hint: Transport after на goes into the prepositional case
